changes_made.explanation: Added additional datasets mentioned in the paper (SciERC, CoNLL04, Re-DOCRED) and clarified outputs to include schema definitions. Normalized model name capitalization.

Simplified the metrics list to the base forms (Precision, Recall, F1) rather than listing all variants separately, as per the normalization guidelines. Kept the specialized metrics for schema evaluation.
Removed placeholder 'None' values and kept empty lists since no LLM-as-judge evaluation was used in this paper.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on knowledge graph construction using LLMs, which involves generating structured relational triplets - making it an NLG task. The extraction was mostly accurate but contained some redundancy in the metadata lists. The paper uses both automatic metrics (precision, recall, F1 variants) and human evaluation, but does not use LLMs as judges post-generation.
